sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive posture dominates market leadership as Energy, Healthcare, and Consumer Defensive post all-green trends while cyclical sectors face sharp deterioration.

Market leadership is concentrated in defensive and commodity-linked sectors, with only 3 of 11 groups maintaining all-green status across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD periods. Energy commands the top overall position with a momentum score of 0.917, while Healthcare and Consumer Defensive show firm multi-timeframe strength. Technology remains a sustained leader holding the rank 2 spot with a 0.767 momentum score, though it sits outside the all-green cohort.

A clear rotation away from economically sensitive groups is underway. Consumer Defensive advanced 3 spots over the last 5 sessions to rank 3, while Basic Materials and Industrials experienced the steepest drops, each falling 2 spots to ranks 5 and 6, respectively. Consumer Cyclical and Utilities anchor the bottom of the market, tied with the lowest momentum scores at 0.250.

## Strength
- **All-Green Cohort:** Only 3 of 11 sectors maintain positive returns across all measured timeframes: Energy (momentum 0.917), Healthcare (momentum 0.783), and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.767).
- **Sustained Leaders:** Healthcare and Technology demonstrate the highest durability, holding top-3 rank consistency across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows.
- **Top Absolute Rank:** Energy firmly retains the #1 spot across both short- and long-term horizons with a 0.917 momentum profile.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Biggest Advancer:** Consumer Defensive surged +3 spots over the past 5 sessions to reach rank 3 (momentum 0.767).
- **De-escalating Cyclicals:** Basic Materials dropped -2 spots to rank 5 (momentum 0.383), and Industrials shed -2 spots to rank 6 (momentum 0.333).
- **Momentum Polarities:** Energy (0.917) and Healthcare (0.783) lead momentum, whereas Consumer Cyclical (0.250, rank 11) and Utilities (0.250, rank 10) lag the broader market.
- **Minor Movers:** Healthcare gained +1 spot to reach rank 4, Financial gained +1 spot to rank 7 (momentum 0.383), and Communication Services fell -1 spot to rank 8 (momentum 0.400).

## Divergences
- **Defensive vs. Cyclical Split:** Consumer Defensive climbed into the top 3 (momentum 0.767), directly contrasting Consumer Cyclical, which is pinned at rank 11 with bottom-tier momentum of 0.250.
- **Technology Rank vs. Trend Breadth:** Technology demonstrates sustained multi-month strength at rank 2 (momentum 0.767), yet fails to qualify alongside Energy, Healthcare, and Consumer Defensive in the all-green breadth category.

rotation_phase.label: Defensive
rotation_phase.reasoning: Healthcare and Consumer Defensive are among the top all-green momentum leaders alongside a sharp drop-off in broader cyclical participation, fitting a defensive market posture despite residual Energy strength.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and healthcare maintain absolute market leadership, while defensive staples surge and tech-adjacent groups flash early distribution warnings.

Traditional energy and healthcare continue to dominate the top tiers of breadth, with Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing holding a perfect 1.00 momentum score alongside sustained leadership in Oil & Gas Integrated (0.929) and Medical Distribution (0.865). Concurrently, a defensive rotation is accelerating over the 5-day window, driven by significant rank advances in Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+22 spots), Beverages - Non-Alcoholic (+15 spots), and Tobacco (+12 spots). 

In contrast, basic materials, travel, and capital-intensive groups are deteriorating rapidly, led by sharp five-session rank drops in Silver (-27 spots) and Airlines (-21 spots). At the same time, high-momentum technology segments are showing early signs of fatigue, with Software - Infrastructure and Semiconductors shedding rank despite solid year-to-date profiles.

## Strength
- **Pervasive Energy Leadership:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing anchors the market with a 1.000 momentum score and rank 1 YTD, joined by Oil & Gas Integrated (0.929 momentum, rank 6 YTD) and Oil & Gas E&P (0.833 momentum, rank 11 YTD).
- **Healthcare & Distribution Durability:** Medical Distribution (0.865 momentum) and Diagnostics & Research (0.838 momentum) remain all-green across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, YTD) with sustained top-36 rankings across 1, 3, and 6 months.
- **Selective High-Momentum Breadth:** 18 of 144 industry groups are all-green, including Consumer Electronics (0.82 momentum), Health Information Services (0.81 momentum), and Insurance - Reinsurance (0.80 momentum).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Rank Advancers:** Shell Companies surged +45 spots to rank 27 (0.79 momentum), Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries jumped +22 spots to rank 63 (0.76 momentum), and Medical Distribution gained +15 spots to rank 44.
- **Severe Short-Term Reversals:** Silver plunged 27 spots to rank 60 (0.42 momentum), while Airlines (-21 spots to rank 110, 0.28 momentum) and Uranium (-21 spots to rank 124, 0.09 momentum) broke down sharply.
- **Entrenched Momentum Laggards:** Mortgage Finance (0.017 momentum, rank 142 YTD), Advertising Agencies (0.041 momentum, rank 144 YTD), and Airports & Air Services (0.064 momentum, rank 141 YTD) remain anchored at the bottom of the market.

## Divergences
- **Fading Tech Momentum:** Software - Infrastructure (momentum 0.72) and Semiconductors (momentum 0.71) dropped 8 and 4 rank spots respectively over the last 5 sessions, signaling distribution beneath high momentum scores.
- **Additional Fading Leaders:** Department Stores (0.73 momentum) and Internet Content & Information (0.65 momentum) both dropped 6 spots in 5-day rank.
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Rebounds:** Waste Management (0.50 momentum), Leisure (0.43 momentum), and Utilities - Regulated Electric (0.45 momentum) each improved by +8 spots in rank over 5 sessions, while Home Improvement Retail gained +7 spots despite a low 0.30 momentum score.
